decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core wafer-handling business, it is relatively cheap to keep available and still offers niche-market learning, so the option value remains positive.

Although technically more demanding, it is a strategic packaging-wafer option tied to the firm's stated direction, so management would keep it while uncertainty about customer adoption and technical payoff is still resolving.
This off-the-shelf brand is very near the established offer and likely low-cost to maintain, making it an attractive commercialization option to keep open.

Because glass-based circuit boards are relatively distant from the firm's narrow core substrate business, and the firm already has several better-aligned options, the learning value no longer justifies continued commitment.
